environment.description: Same IoT gateway service on ECS Fargate in eu-west-1 (production). Split.io workspace 'prod-eu' has the flag 'iot_legacy_hmac_verification' configured with default treatment 'off' and kill switch engaged since 2024-01-15 (flag frozen via Split admin audit log). The targeting rules have zero segments with 'on' treatment. Additionally, the Split SDK is initialized with impression listener that logs to CloudWatch and an SCP on the AWS Organization OU prevents split.io API modifications from any principal except the CI/CD role (arn:aws:iam::*:role/split-admin-ci) which requires approval in Backstage. Note: the code still contains both paths and PyJWT 1.7.1 is still installed in the container image pending security review ticket IOT-4421.

config.split_targeting_rules: 0 segments with on treatment, default rule returns off
config.split_admin_scp: Deny split:UpdateFeatureFlag unless aws:PrincipalArn matches arn:aws:iam::*:role/split-admin-ci
config.network: NLB with public IP, port 8443 open
